messages:
alex: Planning a small deploy to staging at 15:30 PT — pushing the new autoscale policy for the staging-gpu pool (lower min nodes, faster scale-up). Smoke window 15:30-16:00. Who's available to own smoke + rollback? I'll kick off the deploy.

sara: I'll take smoke. What are the exact checks?

alex: Quick checklist: 
- verify pool enters Ready
- run perf-smoke job (small batch) against staging endpoints
- check per-token latency dashboard and pod restart count
- ensure fallback rule triggers if scale-up fails

mike: pinging infra-ops for infra readiness @ryan

ryan: infra good. No maintenance windows. Make sure you set `max_unavailable=1` in rollout controller config.

jia: code LGTM for the policy change — left one minor comment in the PR about the cooldown param.

alex: noted jia — will patch if needed before apply. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/402

deploy-bot: Deploy plan created — https://ci.internal/run/98321 — scheduled for 2025-07-14T22:30:00Z

olivia: I'll watch logs and confirm health-checks. Also can verify KV cache warmup.

sara: smoke steps: 1) curl /health 2) run `python perf_runner.py --batch 8 --seq 512` 3) check Console -> model/latency

alex: rollback plan: revert policy to previous version via terraform and scale pool back to min=4. If rollout fails >5m, pause and rollback. Example revert snippet:
```
terraform apply -var='policy_version=2025-06-01' 
# then: kubectl scale --replicas=4 deployment/staging-gpu-pool
```

mike: FYI I opened an alert rule to notify on sudden latency increase: alert/gpu-pool-latency-high

ryan: can we do a small canary? route 5% of staging traffic to new policy for first 10m.

alex: yes — will enable canary flag in the deploy plan: `canary_percent=5` and `canary_duration=10m`.

sara: all set here, will start smoke at go. please set me as owner in the deploy plan.

alex: thanks all. Starting in ~10min. Will post updates here. :thumbsup:
